_why: ONE definition of what Free and Pro include. Pricing, Terms and Refunds each described a different product: pricing sold advisory detail, install-script contents and permissions; terms committed only to 'the named replacement and the score-history API'; refunds said the same as terms. A customer reading the legal page could not learn that the thing they were sold on the pricing page was included. Every surface is generated from this file, and tests/test_entitlements.py fails the build if any of them disagrees.
_status: live = shipped and reachable today · beta = shipped, may change · planned = NOT built, must never appear as a feature
_delivered_by: the concrete thing a buyer runs or calls. A feature with no delivery path is not a feature.

pro.label: tashan Pro
pro._annual: Set `annual` to activate the monthly/annual toggle on pricing.html. It stays null until a REAL annual price object exists in Polar: the annual button once pointed at the monthly checkout, so anyone choosing annual was billed $6/month and the funnel recorded it as an annual conversion. It was removed rather than left lying (commit f8628ff41f). url must be a DIFFERENT Polar link from the monthly one.
